oracle.statement: control short never-created name returns 404 first (live baseline); then 256/1024/8192-char never-created names: 404 = no defect, 400/414/422 = no defect (explicit rejection), 2xx = Type1_IllegalSuccess, 5xx = Type3_RuntimeFailure; a request-specific transport failure re-checked via GET /healthz: healthz dead = Type3 (crash), healthz alive AND control still 404 = Type3 (this face hangs/DoSes), otherwise SCRIPT_ERROR
